description: A benchmarking script for comparing LiteLLM proxy endpoint versus direct provider endpoint, including request handling, concurrency, warm-up, and statistical analysis.

classes.name: RequestStats
classes.description: Stores statistics for a single HTTP request, including success status, latency, error message, and status code.

classes.name: BenchmarkResults
classes.description: Aggregates multiple request statistics, providing methods to calculate overall metrics such as success rate, latency stats, and error counts.

methods.name: make_request
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous HTTP POST request and returns request statistics.

methods.name: warmup_endpoint
methods.description: Performs warm-up requests to an endpoint to mitigate cold start effects.

methods.name: make_request_with_semaphore
methods.description: Wraps make_request with a semaphore to limit concurrency.

methods.name: benchmark_endpoint
methods.description: Runs a benchmark by sending multiple parallel requests to an endpoint, collecting statistics.

methods.name: print_results
methods.description: Outputs formatted benchmark statistics to the console.

methods.name: aggregate_results
methods.description: Combines multiple BenchmarkResults objects into a single aggregate result.

methods.name: print_run_variance
methods.description: Displays variance metrics across multiple benchmark runs.

methods.name: compare_results
methods.description: Compares and displays differences between proxy and provider benchmark results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function orchestrating the benchmarking process, including argument parsing, setup, execution, and reporting.
